title: BanFakeNews: A Dataset for Detecting Fake News in Bangla
reasoning: The paper mentions religious sentiment and blasphemy as a motivation for creating a fake news dataset, citing an incident involving the destruction of Buddhist temples. However, its primary focus is on the technical task of veracity detection (fake vs. authentic news). The methodology and evaluation do not involve analyzing, evaluating, or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical concepts themselves.
